structure.layout: full-bleed single-screen game title over a WebGL canvas; logo and prompt stacked at left, 3D characters at right

aesthetics.typography: Xingkai SC (brush calligraphy) for the 250px 無雙 logo and headings; Kaiti SC for Chinese menu labels and prompt; Avenir Next for widely letter-spaced uppercase English subtitles (VOXEL MUSOU, PRESS ANY KEY) and body
aesthetics.typeScale: Extreme contrast: 250px bold calligraphic logo, ~43-50px Chinese prompt/menu labels, 16-19px tracked uppercase English captions

notes: Captured state is the 'press any key' title screen after a loading spinner (red 無雙 seal with gold ring). Live 3D voxel scene (canvas) fills the viewport with a dark vignette at left; gold-gradient brush logo with drop shadow; red vertical seal stamps (三國, 常山, 老將) as hanko-style accents; character name plates pair vertical Chinese names with small English labels on dark chips. Keycap-style bordered labels (ENTER) mimic console UI; menu footer shows button prompts (↑↓ Select, Enter/A Confirm). Hidden in DOM: 4-item main menu and a controls reference table with keyboard and gamepad (Xbox/PS glyph) bindings. No codebook pattern is visibly present in the captured title state.
